## Load libraries

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
```

Load dataset, clean column names, convert to appropriate data types, set strings to lowercase

```{r}
df <- read.csv("DATA2X02_2026_2_survey_clean.csv")
#glimpse(df)

# CLEAN COLUMN NAMES
df_short <- clean_names(df)
#summary(df_clean_names)

# REMOVE THE FIRST COLUMN (FULL RESPONSE)
df_short <- df_short[, -1]
#summary(df_short)
colnames(df_short) <- c("age_years",
                        "height_cm",
                        "intl_dom_type",
                        "type_2X02",
                        "grade_1X01",
                        "grade_2X02",
                        "assessment_workflow",
                        "travel_to_campus_min",
                        "rent_y_n",
                        "rent_dollars",
                        "employment_hours",
                        "sleep_hours",
                        "music_type",
                        "aliens_y_n",
                        "water_l",
                        "languages_number",
                        "learning_pathway_n",
                        "learning_pathway_why",
                        "rev_lec_n",
                        "rev_lec_why",
                        "multitask_y_n",
                        "multitask_n",
                        "multitask_why")

# FACTOR CATEGORICAL VARIABLES
df_short <- df_short |>
  mutate(across(c("intl_dom_type", 
                  "type_2X02",
                  "grade_1X01",
                  "grade_2X02",
                  "assessment_workflow",
                  "rent_y_n",
                  "music_type",
                  "aliens_y_n",
                  "languages_number",
                  "learning_pathway_n",
                  "rev_lec_n",
                  "multitask_y_n"), as.factor))

# CHANGE RELEVANT CATEGORICAL VARIABLES TO ORDINAL
df_short <- df_short |>
  mutate(across(c("grade_1X01", "grade_2X02"), 
                ~ factor(.x, 
                         levels = c("P", "CR", "D", "HD"), 
                         ordered = TRUE)))

# CREATING NEW COLUMN: EMPLOYMENT STATUS
df_short <- df_short %>% mutate(employment_y_n = case_when(
  employment_hours == 0 ~ 0,
  employment_hours > 0 ~ 1,
  TRUE ~ NA_integer_
  ), .before = employment_hours) %>%
  mutate(employment_y_n = factor(employment_y_n, 
                                 levels = c(1,0), 
                                 labels = c("yes", "no")))


# SET ALL STRINGS TO LOWERCASE
df_short <- df_short |>
    mutate(learning_pathway_why = str_to_lower(learning_pathway_why)) %>%
    mutate(multitask_why = str_to_lower(multitask_why))

glimpse(df_short)
```

## 

```{r}
#selecting dataset with specific variables
grouping <- c("intl_dom_type", 
              "type_2X02",
              "assessment_workflow",
              "rent_y_n",
              "employment_y_n",
              "multitask_y_n",
              "multitask_n")

ordinal <- c("grade_1X01", "grade_2X02")

numerical <- c("travel_to_campus_min", "rent_dollars", "employment_hours", "sleep_hours", "water_l")

df_clean <- df_short %>% select(all_of(c(grouping, ordinal, numerical)))

#changing y/n responses in rent based on numerical value of rent
df_clean <- df_clean %>% 
  mutate(rent_y_n = if_else(rent_dollars == 0, "no", "yes")) %>%
  mutate(rent_y_n = if_else(rent_dollars > 0, "yes", "no"))

df_clean <- df_clean %>% 
  mutate(multitask_y_n = if_else(multitask_n == "[]", "no", multitask_y_n)) %>%
  mutate(multitask_y_n = if_else(multitask_n != "[]", "yes", multitask_y_n))

df_clean[4:6]<-lapply(df_clean[4:6],factor) #refactorising categorical variables

#filtering outliers and unreasonable values from numerical variables
df_clean <- df_clean %>% filter(travel_to_campus_min <= (3 * 60)) #based on background knowledge


df_clean <- df_clean %>% filter(employment_hours <= (38 * 1.5)) #based on FairWork Ombudsman: An employee can work a maximum of 38 hours in a week unless an employer asks them to work reasonable extra hours, assuming student may work 2 full-time jobs somehow


df_clean <- df_clean %>% filter(sleep_hours <= 13) #decided based on personal inspection of the data

df_clean <- df_clean %>% 
  mutate(sleep_hours = if_else(sleep_hours == 0, median(sleep_hours), sleep_hours)) #physically impossible for someone to sleep 0 hours per night, replace with median


df_clean <- df_clean %>% filter(water_l <= 4) #based on reasonable health guidelines: "For healthy individuals, the average daily water for men is about 15.5 cups (3.67 L) and for women about 11.5 cups (2.72 L)"

df_clean <- df_clean %>% 
  mutate(water_l = if_else(water_l == 0, median(water_l), water_l))

#grouping assessment workflow together for two groups
df_clean <- df_clean %>% mutate(workflow_grouped = case_when(
  assessment_workflow == "Gradually" | 
    assessment_workflow == 
    "Immediately" ~ 0,
  .default = 1), .after = "assessment_workflow") %>%
  mutate(workflow_grouped = factor(workflow_grouped, 
                                 levels = c(0,1), 
                                 labels = c("Consistent", "Inconsistent")))
  
summary(df_clean) #inspecting before exporting

#exporting to csv file for shiny app usage
write.csv(df_clean, "DATA2X02_data_cleaned.csv", row.names = F)
```
